steel-39-global-natural-gas-production-h.rationale: Reconstruct inspected global3.9natural-gas heat production mix at1MJ with all104 positive supplier contributions and original deterministic market weights. Market layers contain no direct emissions, nonheat inputs, uncertain shares or formulas, so flattening deterministic paths does not discard uncertainty. Preserve CHP-versus-heat-only shares and use complete native production-side heat; add no district network or delivery-loss factor. Large conventional and combined-cycle gas CHP use native country CHP heat where present, ENTSO-E otherwise; native cycle/fleet and allocation replace source-specific plant models. Gas engines use native Swiss exergy-allocated300kWth/1MWth heat proxies; source capacities are electrical, target capacities thermal, not equal-scale claims. Boiler/furnace counterparts retain fuel and production class with explicit Swiss/RER geography and capacity proxies. Native allocation, efficiency, infrastructure, stack emissions, technology, geography, vintage, internal uncertainty and biosphere exclusions differ; score effects unquantified. Reference is1MJallocated heat, not1MJfuel; no fuel-demand normalization, avoided-electricity credit, added combustion, efficiency correction or second emissions. Preserve caller signs, quantities, uncertainty, formulas and separate exchanges. Only inspected3.9cutoff; no reverse, other-release or cross-system-model approval.
